messages.subject: RMR2 VS Regular R Streaming
parts:
Hi,

My apologies if this has already been asked, but what are some of the advantages of using RMR2 vs regular R streaming?
Are there any performance considerations?

Thanks

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: RMR2 VS Regular R Streaming
parts:
Jonathan Seidman did a side by side implementation when he was at Orbitz and he has the results on his github account. Michael Smith reported on this very forum a 30X productivity improvement on a project that initially took a few months (but the order in which the two implementations were performed of course is a confounding factor). As far as speed, it depends what you write on top of streaming. If you write like me, it's even ;) But the amount of effort that goes into just one thing, accumulating the groups efficiently on the reduce side, you don't want to go through that if you don't have to, believe me.

Antonio
